payload.summary:
Two unauthorised persons boarded a barge under tow.
Nearby vessels alerted the tug master who boarded the
barge for inspection resulting in the persons escaping. It
was reported that two containers onboard the barge were
broken into and contents stolen. Incident reported to the
local authorities.
